summary.text: Dave Sires, a Republican, represents District 38 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Sires as serving a first term.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes Sires as the owner and operator of a manufactured housing community and self-storage facility and a former Cedar Falls City Council member.
It says Sires graduated from Cedar Falls High School, attended the University of Northern Iowa, was born in 1960 in Cedar Falls and lives there.
